verdict.rationale: Automated flagging of anomalous or out-of-policy transactions is a fair question for a business payments product, but the evidence pack never documents AI or automated anomaly detection that surfaces transactions for review. Spend-control rules (MCC/currency) only permit or block card transactions, which is an adjacent control. Transaction retrieval APIs and webhooks are developer building blocks a user could build on, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI flag anomalous or out-of-policy transactions automatically for review
